admin.demoBanner: Operator console, demonstration mode. Data is generated from a seed on every request and no action here writes anything.
admin.error.readOnlyDemo: This console is read-only. The demo dataset is regenerated from a seed on every request, so a saved row would disappear on the next tick — the form refuses rather than pretending otherwise.
admin.dashboard.title: Dashboard
admin.dashboard.demoNotice: Every figure below is derived from the simulated dataset. None of it is revenue, none of it is a real player, and none of it is reportable.
admin.stat.totalStakeHint: The sum of every stake in the sandbox ledger. This is not revenue, not gross gaming yield and not a reportable figure.
admin.column.name: Name
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.description: The synthetic player population. Every address is on a reserved domain and reaches nobody.
admin.events.title: Events
admin.events.description: Every fixture on the board, with its status and market count.
admin.events.createDescription: Define a fixture and its opening status.
admin.events.demoNotice: The fields are real; the submit is not. This console cannot write to the demo dataset.
admin.field.title: Title
admin.sports.title: Sports
admin.sports.description: Catalogue and current volume per sport.
admin.competitions.title: Competitions
admin.bets.title: Bets
admin.bets.description: Every simulated ticket in the sandbox.
admin.transactions.title: Transactions
admin.promotions.title: Promotions
admin.promotions.description: Offers, their status and their window.
admin.promotions.createDescription: Define an offer and its window.
admin.promotions.reviewNotice: Every offer must pass advertising review before publication: no claim that betting is a way to make money, nothing that could reach a minor, and terms stated in full at the point of the offer.
admin.reports.title: Reports
admin.reports.description: Volume and distribution across the board.
admin.reports.demoNotice: Derived from simulated data. A licensed operator reports against a certified settlement engine, not a dashboard.
admin.reports.bySportDescription: Share of the current fixture list.
admin.reports.regulatoryBody: Gaming duty, player-fund reconciliation, suspicious-activity reporting and periodic returns would all be produced here, from the ledger rather than from aggregates, and retained for the period the licence requires.
admin.responsible.title: Responsible gambling
admin.responsible.description: Active exclusions, cooling-off periods and limit activity across the population.
admin.responsible.demoNotice: Nothing here is enforced. In a real deployment every one of these is a server-side control: a self-excluded account must be blocked at the wagering and deposit endpoints, not only in the interface.
admin.responsible.noCasesDescription: Exclusions and cooling-off periods would appear here as players set them.
admin.settings.title: System settings
admin.settings.description: Read from the configuration module, not typed out here.
admin.settings.licenceMissing: No licence is configured, and none may be. This build must not be operated. Every gate below has to close first.
admin.rgCase.detail.limitIncreasePending: A limit increase is held in the cooling-off window
admin.rgCase.detail.limitReached: The player has reached a configured limit
admin.games.title: Games
admin.games.description: Casino catalogue and provider connection state.
admin.games.demoNotice: Only the in-house provider is connected, and only because it is this codebase. Every third-party title is listed and unopenable — the catalogue is the shape a licensed operator's would take, not an offer.
admin.games.summary: {connected} of {providers} providers connected · {playable} of {total} titles playable.
